notes.title: DISCORD CHANNEL + OPEN BETA PLAYTESTS!
notes.content:
We now have an Discord channel! You can join us by clicking here: https://discord.gg/ZyRCqUH

We created it to make it easier for you to talk to devs and receive updates. We're also going to start some open beta playtests next week, so make sure to join to be notified when the servers are open!
